subject: English
passage: Linguists investigating tonal variation have discovered why certain highland communities in Southeast Asia developed rising tone patterns when other regional languages use falling ______ in mountainous areas, acoustic properties favor upward pitch movement for long-distance communication, but in valleys, downward tones carry more effectively across flat terrain.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is colon use within a sentence. A colon used in this way introduces information that illustrates or explains information that has come before it. In this case, the colon introduces the following explanation of why certain highland communities in Southeast Asia developed rising tone patterns when other regional languages use falling tones.
